remarks: This bright and airy home with spacious rooms is available January 15th. Cook your favorite meal in the new white kitchen with large seating area that opens to the family room with fireplace, perfect for hosting big viewing parties or relaxing by the fire. Kitchen also opens to porch with walls of windows. Dine al fresco in the private backyard or patio. Take advantage of the large rec room also located off the porch. There is a first floor primary suite with full bath and fireplace. There is another sun-filled bedroom with its own updated full bath. An open office with built-ins and laundry area complete the first floor. Upstairs there are two more bedrooms and a new full bath. Move in and enjoy. Minutes to school, town, parkway, and train. Enjoy all Fairfield County has to offer including award-winning schools!
